outcome: The exit-fill drag is real (mean -0.431%, 95% CI [-0.930%, -0.132%], excludes zero) but the annualized SMALL_ADV_Q1-vs-ALL differential (-0.015%/yr) is far below the pre-registered 0.5%/yr materiality bar. The hypothesis that exit-fill realism is a MATERIAL driver of the G8-07/G8-11 tier effect is REJECTED -- this mechanism, while genuine, does not explain a meaningful share of the lead. G8-12's crude bound (0 to -2.29%/yr) is superseded by this far smaller modeled figure.
